name: Retaliation

subjectOf.text: The AIFM Directive could create incentives for regulatory arbitrage and could provoke retaliatory action by countries outside the European Union.
subjectOf.abstract: The AIFM Directive could create incentives for regulatory arbitrage and potentially cause retaliatory action by non-EU countries.
subjectOf.citation: Kaal, Hedge Fund Regulation Via Basel III (2011). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=1806252
scope_conditions: non-EU funds and managers face restricted access to EU markets

subjectOf.text: Discrimination against non-EU jurisdictions under the AIFM Directive could provoke retaliatory action, and retaliation combined with a lack of intra-European cooperation could damage the European financial services industry and the whole European economy.
subjectOf.abstract: Discrimination against non-EU jurisdictions could provoke retaliatory action. As a consequence, retaliatory actions and a lack of intra-European cooperation could damage the European financial services industry and the whole European economy.
subjectOf.citation: Kaal, Hedge Fund Regulation Via Basel III (2011). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=1806252
scope_conditions: obstacles to EU market access for non-EU funds and managers persist
